intent: A classic-catalog gothic lolita gown with the colours inverted: a deep crimson bodice laced in black and a bell-sleeved, tiered crimson skirt trimmed in black lace and bone, with black bows and a clock-pinned headdress, reading from the high camera as a narrow-shouldered crimson bell under a bowed head.
requests: A cone or tapered cylinder shape, so a full skirt can flare smoothly in one part instead of stacked round drums.
